brief:
Palestinian artist Saint Levant has postponed his scheduled US tour after encountering visa complications, Al Jazeera English reported. The musician cited difficulties obtaining entry authorization as the primary reason for delaying performances across multiple venues in the country.

The setback reflects mounting obstacles international performers face when seeking to enter the United States. Visa cancellations and processing delays have forced numerous musicians and touring acts to reconsider or reschedule their American dates in recent months, complicating international concert schedules and tour logistics for artists across multiple genres and regions.
dek: Visa cancellations or delays have forced international artists to rethink US tours under President Donald Trump.
title: Palestinian artist Saint Levant postpones US tour citing visa denial
